D2 = A (P0/S2): the narrator writes prose only, the extractor reads each reply afterwards. delta-0.2 against the P0 draft delta-0.1-draft: expected of a pending buy/pay also asks taken_anyway (P0/S2 v12_08: the reply had Alaric take the room unasked, the free overreach delta was missed, the expected fields were 25/25); position, aware, intent and thread as in 3.x; creature.new and person.new carry the distance band a fight needs; check without the numbers the prose does not show. delta-0.3 (product 4.0): expected of a sell asks sold and price_cp (the world applier books a sale by them; before, a sell fell back to {done} and could never be booked); no delta type changed. delta-0.4 (live run 28.09.2026): the extractor also reads the PLAYER MESSAGE; what it has Alaric say or do himself ("*i sign the card*") is never overreach, a payment, purchase, acceptance, registration or journey that PLAYER ACTIONS did not book still is; a name Alaric gives is learned by those who hear it; no delta type changed. delta-0.5 (live run 28.09.2026 afternoon): name learning requires diegetic transmission; deltas caused only by an overreaching Alaric action are omitted; no delta type changed. delta-0.6 (live run 28.09.2026 15:17): an engine-resolved SEARCH CHECK is never re-reported as a check; tracks/signs of an unseen unknown creature are evidence, not creature.new; Guild quest.detail may add operational fiction but never payout/proof/completion/rank mechanics; no delta type changed.
rules: Report only what THIS reply establishes, in the order it happens (seq 1, 2, 3 …). Invent nothing.
Alaric's own decisions are in PLAYER ACTIONS and already booked by the engine; never report them as deltas (no payment, purchase, acceptance, turn-in, pick-up of his).

If the reply has Alaric decide something that neither PLAYER ACTIONS nor the PLAYER MESSAGE contain, report it only as overreach. What the PLAYER MESSAGE has him say or do himself (his words, a gesture, signing, sitting down) is his own, never overreach; but coin, goods, contracts, registration and journeys change only as PLAYER ACTIONS book them: a payment, purchase, pick-up, acceptance, turn-in, registration or journey that the reply shows, that PLAYER ACTIONS do not book and the CATALOG does not show as done already, is overreach, even when the PLAYER MESSAGE has him do it. If another apparent world change exists only because of that overreaching Alaric action, do not emit it as a second delta: report the overreach only.
Answer every key of expected; each key asks about the PLAYER ACTION with the same number.
Known places, people, quests and objects by their id from the CATALOG; a new place as {"new": {"name", "kind", "parent"}} (parent: a place id or one more {"new": …}).

Prices and coin are integers in copper (1 silver = 10 copper, 1 gold = 100 copper). The Guild's contract payout and its registration fee are the engine's; report the story's words about them only as facts.
Official Guild contracts come only from the engine's BOARD; never report a new one (if the reply shows one the BOARD lacks: overreach guild_listing).
A price someone merely mentions is a fact; an offer is a price for something Alaric could buy now.

A person learns Alaric's name only from diegetic evidence: Alaric explicitly says it where they hear him, or visibly writes/shows it where the reply establishes they read it. Third-person narration merely calling the protagonist "Alaric" or "Alaric Red" is never evidence that an NPC learned his name.

An engine-resolved SEARCH CHECK already shown in PLAYER ACTIONS is already booked by the engine. Never emit a check delta for that search. Emit check only when the reply actually used the separate generic CHECK DIE issued for the turn.

Tracks, spoor, hair, a wallow, sounds, shadows or other evidence of an unseen/unknown creature are evidence, not creature.new. Report the evidence as a fact or thread. Use creature.new only when the reply establishes the creature itself as an actual individual/group with a species the engine can map.

For a known Guild contract, quest.detail may add only non-mechanical operational details such as a contact person, meeting place, route or schedule. Never add or change Guild payout/payment/reward, required proof, completion/turn-in rules, Guild rank or fees in quest.detail; omit those sentences instead.

activity.summary: how long it took, and whether he finished

buy.summary: did someone name a price; did the reply have Alaric take, use or pay for it although he had not agreed

pay.summary: did someone name the amount; did the reply have Alaric pay anyway

sell.summary: did a buyer take it and pay, and how much

deltas.summary: story time that passed
Alaric arrives somewhere (only after a GOES action or when forced)
a person the reply introduces; name only a proper name, else null; present: here with Alaric now; at: where they are if not here

creatures the reply itself establishes as actual creatures; never tracks/spoor/hair/sounds alone; count > 1 for several of one kind (the engine makes each its own creature); band: distance to Alaric when it matters for a fight
a known person comes into the scene
a person leaves or stays behind
a lasting world fact (not about what Alaric holds, pays or has decided)
what a person now knows
a real change in how someone regards Alaric
a moment people will remember
a physical thing that now exists (holder: a place id, "here" or a person); Alaric holds it only after his TAKES or GATHERS action
someone else hands or moves an object (to Alaric: "pc"); never away from Alaric
an object gets a mark ("signed by the waystation master")
someone names prices; lines: what, kind (goods|service), service (lodging, bath, laundry, meal, healing, training, other or null), qty, price_cp
someone gives Alaric coin of their own will (never the Guild's payout)
something is taken from Alaric against his will (never by the other side of a sale)
private work someone offers (never a Guild contract)

the giver or Guild desk adds a non-mechanical operational detail (contact, meeting place, route, schedule); for Guild contracts never payout/payment/reward, proof, completion/turn-in, rank or fee rules
an objective visibly advanced (information only)
private work closed by its giver; a Guild contract only as failed (it became impossible): Guild contracts are completed only when Alaric turns them in at a Guild hall
a board listing is taken by someone else or withdrawn
who commits to attack Alaric right now
where someone present now stands relative to Alaric (outside a fight)
whether someone present has noticed Alaric
what someone hostile means to do on their next turn
a story thread that will matter again (a threat, a promise, a debt), or one that is resolved now
only if the reply used the separate generic CHECK DIE of this turn; never re-report an engine-resolved SEARCH CHECK
rest or healing outside combat
the reply had Alaric decide something he had not decided (no state change)
